questionnaires.title: Alternative Thoughts Worksheet (CPT)
questionnaires.description: The central CPT worksheet, gathering every tool into one unit: identifying the situation, thought and emotion, examining the thought with the exploring questions and thinking patterns, and finding a more balanced alternative thought — with ratings of belief in the thought and of emotion intensity.

items.text: A. Situation — describe the event, thought, or belief leading to the unpleasant emotion(s).
B. Thought / Stuck Point — write down the thought or Stuck Point related to the situation in section A.
items.ratingText: How much do you believe this thought?

items.text: C. Emotion(s) — what do you feel (sad, angry, etc.)?
items.ratingText: How strongly do you feel this emotion?

items.text: What do you mean? Write the Stuck Point clearly enough that a stranger would understand exactly what is troubling you.
D. Exploring Questions — examine the Stuck Point with the questions below (see the Exploring Questions Worksheet). Answer the ones that are relevant; you do not need to answer them all.
What is the evidence against the thought?
What information are you not including about the thought?
Is the thought worded in all-or-none, extreme or exaggerated terms? How could it be worded more evenly?
Is the thought overfocused on just one piece of the event? What other parts matter here?
Is the source of information for the thought questionable? How?
Is the thought confusing something possible with something definite? How?
Is the thought based on feelings rather than facts? Which facts contradict the feeling?
E. Thinking Patterns — does the thought reflect one of the patterns below (see the Thinking Patterns Worksheet)? Where a pattern applies, describe how it shows up.
Jumping to conclusions or predicting the future
Ignoring important parts of a situation
Oversimplifying or overreaching
Mind reading
Emotional reasoning
F. Alternative Thought — what else can you say to yourself instead of the Stuck Point above? How else could you interpret the event?
items.ratingText: How much do you believe the alternative thought?

items.text: G. Rerate old thought / Stuck Point — how much do you now believe the Stuck Point you wrote above?

labels.min: Do not believe it at all

items.text: H. Emotion(s) — what do you feel now, thinking the alternative thought?
items.ratingText: How strongly do you feel this?
